_readme: Geographic data for the dashboard's 'Real-World IoT Application Simulation' section. Kept separate from simulation metrics (figure_data.csv / final_research.json) so physical-world context is never confused with NS-3 results. Only one coordinate in this file is sourced from the existing repository (dashboard/app.py's defaultCenter, itself marked 'approximate'). Every other point is an explicit, clearly-labelled PLACEHOLDER pending researcher confirmation -- none were fabricated as if surveyed or real.

anchor.name: Prince of Songkla University, Phuket Campus
anchor.source: existing repository config (dashboard/app.py defaultCenter), marked approximate
anchor.description: The researcher's institution -- the one geographic point already present in this repository prior to this feature. Shown as real-world context only.

conceptual_deployment._note: PLACEHOLDER locations only. Coordinates below are illustrative points scattered near the anchor for layout purposes and are NOT surveyed, confirmed, or research-verified locations. They must be replaced with researcher-confirmed coordinates before any claim of real deployment sites.
